newsitem.title: ITALY: Unicem 4-month sales up, Buzzis on board.
newsitem.headline: Unicem 4-month sales up, Buzzis on board.

text.p: Italian cement group Unicem on Thursday reported that sales in the first four months of 1997 had risen 18 percent while it also announced two new board members from fellow cement group Fratelli Buzzi.

Unicem's chairman Luca Paveri Fontana told the group's annual shareholder meeting that the group will pay a 1996 ordinary dividend of 160 lire per share, after nil the previous year, and a savings share dividend of 229 lire.

In May, Unicem said that a 20.5 percent stake in the company held by Agnelli family holding IFIL will be sold to Fratelli Buzzi with an option for Fratelli Buzzi to acquire more shares from IFIL to increase its stake up to 27.6 percent. Before the deal, IFIL held 50.3 percent of Unicem.
The meeting voted to appoint Sandro and Franco Buzzi onto the Unicem board, with the former also joining the executive committee.
